title: `entire disable` does not reach linked worktrees: settings.local.json is per worktree, so a new `git worktree add` comes back enabled

worker.report:
`entire disable` now applies to every linked worktree of the clone, and the new test passes. I ran only that test, so the rest of the suite hasn't been run against this change.

The fix follows the issue's proposal in part:
- **Clone preferences:** `ClonePreferences` gains an `enabled` flag, and `applyClonePreferences` applies it. The merge order is now `settings.json`, then clone preferences, then `settings.local.json`.
- **Writing the flag:** the local-scope branch of `setEnabledFlag` writes `enabled` to `.git/entire/preferences.json`. It still writes `settings.local.json` as before.

I did not do these parts of the proposal:
- Re-syncing the mirror on `entire enable --project`.
- The "already enabled" short-circuit change in `runEnableOnConfiguredRepo`.
- The `Clone · enabled|disabled` line in `entire status --detailed`.

Without the re-sync, `entire enable --project` leaves the mirror as it was. A mirrored `false` therefore stays in effect.

The test disables Entire in the main worktree, creates a linked worktree that has only the committed `settings.json`, and checks that `IsEnabled` returns false there. It failed before the change.

Test added: `TestRunDisable_AppliesToLinkedWorktrees`
Files changed: `cmd/entire/cli/setup_disable_worktree_test.go` (new), `cmd/entire/cli/settings/settings.go`, `cmd/entire/cli/setup.go`

worker.report:
The fix is in place. The earlier regressions came from the new clone-preferences write failing in tests that run outside a git repo. I made that write conditional on `settings.ClonePreferencesPath(ctx)` succeeding, so outside a repo `runEnable` and `runDisable` skip it. The earlier attempt wrote the mirror unconditionally.

I ran `go test ./cmd/entire/cli/ -run 'TestRunDisable|TestRunEnable'` and it passes. That pattern includes the previously failing `TestRunDisable*` and `TestRunEnable*` tests and the new worktree test. I did not run the rest of the suite.

Test added: `TestRunDisable_AppliesToLinkedWorktrees`
Files changed: `cmd/entire/cli/settings/settings.go`, `cmd/entire/cli/setup.go`, `cmd/entire/cli/setup_disable_worktree_test.go`
